Start: Lumra, Bellow of the Woods (battlefield); Famished Worldsire (battlefield); Eldrazi Confluence (hand); Stone-Seeder Hierophant (battlefield: without summoning sickness); Donnie & April, Adorkable Duo (battlefield)
